  ((r₁ : A) + 1) ^ (p * l) * l.factorial * B ^ l * 2 ^ (p * l * r₁)
example (p r₁ : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (l : ℕ) : formula ℝ p r₁ B l =
    ((r₁ : ℝ) + 1) ^ (p * l) * l.factorial * B ^ l * 2 ^ (p * l * r₁) := rfl
#check @Nat.factorial
#check @pow_mul
#check @mul_right_comm
#check @Nat.cast_pow
#check @one_le_pow₀
#check @one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le
#check @Nat.factorial_pos
example (p r₁ l : ℕ) : formula ℝ p r₁ 1 l =
    (((r₁ + 1) ^ (p * l) * l.factorial * 2 ^ (p * l * r₁) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
  simp only [formula, one_pow, mul_one, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
    Nat.cast_ofNat]
#print axioms formula
end Lem6M182Isolated
